policy: Append findings; never erase an unresolved error. A closing entry must point to the fix commit/hash and a reproducing test.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P04: p04-parser-contracts
entries.resolution: Test corrected to validate the schema definition with validate_schema_definition rather than calling validate_data, which validates instances against schemas. This was a test-layer mismatch, not a parser/runtime defect.
entries.resolution_validation: The corrected parser/type suite passed all 27 tests (exit code 0).

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P04: p04-parser-contracts-retest
entries.resolution: Corrected an over-escaped regular expression in the negative test. The test now asserts the documented exception type directly and no longer relies on a malformed regex.
entries.resolution_validation: The corrected parser/type suite passed all 27 tests (exit code 0).

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P05: patch-p05-interpreter-scope-and-ordering
entries.resolution: The earlier patch helper targeted a code layout that had changed during interpreter reconstruction and stopped at its guard assertion before modifying source. The intended corrections were re-applied directly to validate_ast_static, then the complete 32-test P05 operator suite passed.
entries.resolution_validation: Python syntax check passed; 32 interpreter tests passed with exit code 0.

entries.description: An initial shell here-document wrote only a prefix of interpreter.py and py_compile correctly rejected the incomplete file. This was a source-file authoring failure; it was not treated as a runtime pass.
entries.resolution: Rewrote interpreter.py in separately delimited, syntax-checked sections and added execution tests for each canonical operator.
entries.resolution_validation: py_compile returned 0 and all 32 test_p05_interpreter tests passed.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P05: p05-interpreter-operator-suite
entries.resolution: The first invocation was missing the source-tree import path; the package is in src/ and was not installed into the environment. Rerun with PYTHONPATH=src passed the 26-test operator suite.
entries.resolution_validation: Rerun returned exit code 0; operator suite ran 26 tests.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P05: p05-operator-matrix-check
entries.resolution: The matrix referenced stale test method names. Mapped each canonical operator to existing current test methods; the matrix checker reports 29/29 dispatch branches, 29/29 matrix entries, and 29/29 resolved test names.
entries.resolution_validation: Checker reports PASS, canonical_count=29, dispatch_count=29, matrix_count=29.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P05: p05-negative-schema-coverage-matrix
entries.resolution: The test incorrectly expected 28 operators with required fields; AST catalogue has 27 operators with mandatory fields and two option-only shapes. Changed the assertion to the verified catalogue property; all 4 negative-matrix tests passed.
entries.resolution_validation: Corrected negative schema matrix returned exit code 0; 4 tests passed.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P05: p05-snapshot-commit-protocol
entries.resolution: A helper script had an unmatched parenthesis and failed before its source-edit steps. Corrected the script syntax and reran it successfully; the full suite subsequently passed.
entries.resolution_validation: Corrected helper ran with exit code 0; full suite after patch passed 102 tests.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P06: p06-sqlite-service-functional-suite
entries.resolution: The first fixture-corruption test expected a raw JSONDecodeError. The durable adapter was hardened to wrap malformed persisted JSON in the typed MemoryIntegrityError and the corruption behavior now passes the full test suite.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P06: p06-sqlite-v2-regression-suite
entries.resolution: The migration test fixture still asserted schema version 1 and omitted the newly introduced v2 subscription rows. The test fixture/expectation was updated for the versioned v2 contract; v1-to-v2 migration and preservation checks now pass.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P06: p06-wave-protocol-test-expansion
entries.resolution: The initial test-generation helper had an indentation error and stopped before writing the test changes; the helper was corrected and the wave protocol tests were added and exercised.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P06: p06-wave-protocol-tests
entries.resolution: The first expansion run had a missing BudgetExceeded import and assumed repeated explicit replay requests must be rejected. The import was fixed; repeated user-requested replay is permitted only as a new audited attempt, and the current replay audit suite passes.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P06: p06-wave-parity-and-ast-contract-suite
entries.resolution: The test configured max_receive_batch=4 but requested the default batch of 100. The scenario now uses a limit within the declared test configuration.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P06: p06-wave-parity-and-ast-contract-suite-retest
entries.resolution: A second parity scenario used the default receive limit (100) despite max_receive_batch=4. The test was changed to request a batch within the configured cap and passed on retest.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P06: p06-wave-parity-and-ast-contract-suite-retest2
entries.resolution: The replay scenario requested the default replay limit of 100 despite max_receive_batch=4. The test now requests one replay item and the targeted suite passes.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P07: p07-frontier-integrity-regression
entries.resolution: Le test attendait l’ancienne forme du frontier. La nouvelle version de recherche a un schéma versionné; le test a été mis à jour pour vérifier les champs/version et l’immuabilité du frontier d’origine.
entries.resolution_validation: Retest ciblé réussi puis suite globale P07 réussie avec 160 tests; le défaut était une assertion obsolète du test, pas le moteur.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P07: p07-integrated-lazy-cegis-tests
entries.resolution: La réponse du cas sans candidat retenait le nombre de contre-exemples mais omettait la liste nécessaire à l’audit. La sortie a été corrigée pour conserver les contre-exemples et leur hash.
entries.resolution_validation: Retest ciblé réussi (46 tests) et suite complète réussie (160 tests).

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P07: p07-randomized-frontier-and-sqlite-restart
entries.resolution: Les tests adversariaux ont montré deux problèmes distincts : les slots à coûts non monotones ne respectaient pas l’ordre global de priorité et le test attendait à tort l’état terminal générique SELECTED plutôt que l’état explicitant la sélection évaluée d’une hypothèse.
entries.resolution_validation: La normalisation des choix par (coût normalisé, indice d’origine) rend l’énumération best-first déterministe. La reprise SQLite et les tests ciblés passent; la suite complète passe avec 165 tests (logs/executions/P07/20261026T111146395157+0000_p07-full-suite-after-adversarial-hardening.receipt.json).

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P07: p07-randomized-frontier-and-sqlite-restart-retest
entries.resolution: La canonicalisation JSON rejetait NaN/Inf avant que le validateur ne les convertisse en diagnostic de validation typé. Le calcul du digest capture maintenant les erreurs de sérialisation et les remonte comme ValidationError.
entries.resolution_validation: Les cas NaN, Inf, coût booléen, négatif, chaîne et slots mal formés passent maintenant les assertions de rejet typé; les tests ciblés et la suite complète (165) passent.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P07: p07-independent-oracle-integration-tests
entries.resolution: L’échec de première intégration a été corrigé lors de la liaison du contrat oracle et du schéma AST v1.3.0. Le retest ciblé, la suite oracle/frontier et la suite globale sont réussis.
entries.resolution_validation: Les trois reçus référencés déclarent PASS et exit_code=0; le dernier rapporte 168 tests réussis.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P08: p08-ascrc-and-world-gate-targeted-tests
entries.resolution: Deux assertions de test ne correspondaient pas au contrat d’état opérationnel : une révocation exclut le candidat mais n’interdit pas le planificateur sur tout le catalogue; un réveil insuffisamment financé laisse une demande mémorisée et le candidat BLOCKED. Le code a été testé de nouveau avec ces attentes corrigées.
entries.resolution_validation: Retest P08 ciblé : 27 tests PASS; suite complète : 195 tests PASS.

entries.description: Checked command failed during phase P08: p08-ascrc-and-world-gate-targeted-retest
entries.resolution: La modification des assertions a touché à tort un test distinct qui doit refuser un budget inférieur à la consommation active stale. L’assertion de budget dur a été rétablie; le test ciblé et la suite complète sont ensuite passés.
entries.resolution_validation: Le test sur stale active usage réserve 2 unités jusqu’au stop sûr; un budget de 1 est refusé; 27 tests ciblés et 195 tests globaux PASS.
